verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 4 remains approved. The workflow passes the issue event's type through a quoted environment variable, while retriage obtains the mutable type from the same fail-closed live read as body and state and distinguishes GitHub's explicit null from absent or malformed schema. Normalization remains centralized at the classifier boundary; mapped-type precedence, area fallback, and the trust-surface override are preserved. The tests discriminate workflow binding, CLI and live-read forwarding, typed versus untyped label outcomes, malformed documents, and trust-surface precedence. The regate entry-point clock is wired into the real Sweeper and tested in both live and stale directions; the dry-run no-write assertion is paired with a census proving useful work was actually classified. No blocker, major, minor, or nit finding is supported by the diff, and no reviewer-directed instruction appears in it.
